evidence.summary: Eye-level + panorama captures show blue Glacier-ice seracs, 30-stud ice monolith, dark moraine boulders, and snow-capped rock cliff ring on a snow floor, all correctly scaled to the dummy rigs.

reasons: All 6 brief elements present and readable at character scale: snow floor, blue Glacier seracs (8-15 studs = 1.5-3x char), hero monolith (30 studs), 30 dark moraine boulders, snow-capped rock cliff ring, cold blue Atmosphere
Cover geometry, focal landmark, and material coherence (Glacier ice + rock + snow) clear the above-generic bar; dark moraine gives needed contrast against the blue
Minor gaps only (no distinct background peaks beyond the ring; palette leans monochrome-blue) — not disqualifying

config.theme: Frozen glacier-basin combat arena: packed-snow floor with ice rim, jagged blue Glacier ice seracs as cover pillars, a hero ice monolith focal landmark, scattered dark moraine boulders, ringed by sculpted snow-capped rock cliffs and background peaks under cold twilight lighting + blue Atmosphere

steps: Referenced glacier/serac photos; noted offset snow-capped rock courses, jagged blue ice cliffs, dark moraine on pale floor, size gradient to peaks
Built a 120-stud Sand snow floor cylinder + Glacier ice rim ring
Sculpted a 14-mass terrain cliff ring (Rock+Snow, offset radii, back ridge taller) + 2 hero back peaks, then added angular FillBlock crags to break round blobs

Placed 10 modular ice seracs (3-shard Glacier clusters + snow base) clustered for cover with central negative space; a 3-spire IceMonolith focal landmark; 30 clustered moraine boulders with snow caps and size gradient

Authored cold twilight lighting: ClockTime 16.6, warm ColorShift_Top vs cool non-black OutdoorAmbient, matched Sky, tuned Atmosphere (Density 0.30/Offset 0.45/blue Decay), ordered post (ColorCorrection cool grade -> threshold Bloom -> SunRays), cool accent PointLights in ice
Verified via capture_angles + eye-level camera against references: focal monolith, 3 depth planes, human scale vs AgentRig, jagged crag boundary all read coherent

recipe.text: Fresh concept distinct from prior arenas (glacier basin). Floor=Sand snow cylinder + Glacier rim; cover=reusable 3-shard Glacier seracs (translucent, Reflectance) clustered leaving center clear; focal=3-spire ice monolith at back; boundary=terrain Rock/Snow cliff ring with angular crags + background hero peaks implying a larger world. Mood=cold twilight, warm/cool light separation, tuned blue Atmosphere for depth, restrained ordered post grade, contained cool accent lights. Verified at player eye level: character reads 5-stud vs ~2-3x-tall seracs; coherent, intentional space matching glacier references.
